text: Select: ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), MeSH heading (mesh_heading), EFO term (efo_term), max phase for indication (max_phase_for_ind). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase equals 4. drug_indication.mesh_heading contains 'lymphoma'. Return all matching rows.
